channel.title: LoomSci - Quantum Physics
channel.description: Latest Quantum Physics articles from LoomSci

item.title: Geometry Learns to Protect Privacy: A Quantum Fisher Information Approach
item.description: Quantum Fisher Information eigenstructure reveals which directions most threaten privacy, guiding noise precisely where it matters.

item.title: The Quantum Battery That Waits a Hundred Thousand Years
item.description: A nuclear isomer quantum battery stores energy for up to a hundred thousand years, releasing it on demand via X-ray laser pulses.

item.title: Remembering Forever: A Local Automaton for Topological Quantum Memory
item.description: A hierarchical local automaton of qubits on a torus corrects errors using only nearest-neighbor operations, protecting a logical quantum memory for exponentially long times.

item.title: When Orbitals Learn to Absorb: Cutting Quantum Correlations Down to Size
item.description: By co-optimizing orbitals with a sparse configuration interaction wavefunction, quantum chemists compress an astronomically large determinant space into a compact set, dramatically accelerating convergence.

item.title: The Ghost That Reveals Hidden Electronic Coherence
item.description: Entangled photon pairs uncouple time and energy resolution, revealing electronic coherence in molecular aggregates that classical spectroscopy cannot see.

item.title: A 3,000-Qubit System Learns to Refuel Itself
item.description: Optical conveyor belts reload fresh qubits into a 3,000-atom array every fraction of a second, enabling continuous quantum computation without stopping.
